BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BE   SEMESTER: VI
BRANCH: CHEM P&P   SESSION : SP/2020

SUBJECT : PC6001 POLYMER BLENDS & COMPOSITES

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) Classify the polymer alloys and blends on the basis of Miscibility with examples. [2]
 (b) State the advantages of blending of polymers from the point of view of improvement in
their resulting properties.
[3]


Q2 (a) What are the different types of force of attraction plays in interface? [2]
 (b) List the methods of blending. Explain mechanical mixing in detail. [3]


Q3 (a) Two  polymers  were  mixed  together  and  prepared  a  sample  sheet  using  compression
molding. Can the resultant product be called polymer blend?
[2]
 (b) Explain the Differential Scanning Calorimetry technique to characterize a blend. [3]


Q4 (a) Compare the physical compatibilization and reactive compatibilization? [2]
 (b) What are the advantages of Reactive compatibilization? [3]


Q5 (a) Explain  the  how  to  use  known  model system  to  predict  rheology  of  miscible  polymer
blends.
[2]
 (b) Explain the Thermo Gravimetric Analysis to characterize a blend. [3]


Q6 (a) State the Flory-Huggins theory. [2]
 (b) Describe its application to polymer blend miscibility. [3]

Q1 (a) Define polymer blends and Composites. Give examples [2]
 (b) Write short notes on Blend preparation methods and give example of each. [3]


Q2 (a) Why do we prefer IPNs over mechanical blends? [2]
 (b) Classify IPNs and give example of each. [3]


Q3 (a) How can we distinguish between a miscible blend and an immiscible blend? [2]
 (b) What are the conditions of miscibility of polymer blends? [3]


Q4 (a) Classify composites. [2]
 (b) Define interfacial thickness. What are the factors controlling interfacial thickness? [3]


Q5 (a) Write at least two applications of MMC and CMC. [2]
 (b) What are the demerits of MMC and CMC? Explain the reason of such demerits. [3]


Q6 (a) Draw a typical pultrusion unit. [2]
 (b) What are the differences between thermoplastic and thermoset based composites? [3]
